name: v0.26.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Replace local viewer Shiki highlighting with Pierre Highlights by @alexgshaw in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3906
* fix(sail): SDK file copies, 1800 s copies, non-login compose shell, healthcheck reason; DinD cleanup never masks a result by @charley3c in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3818
* fix: unblock Windows unit tests by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3910
* docs: add v0.25.0 changelog highlights by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3909
* Fix Windows artifact directory probing by @MarcoRossignoli in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3912
* feat(agents): reuse an agent the environment already ships by @WamboDNS in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3657
* Respect nested harborignore rules and flag unused files in lint by @scvance in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3708
* feat(agents): share the installed-version check and use it for opencode by @WamboDNS in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3823
* fix(vercel): support vercel-sandbox >= 0.7 by @kajogo777 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3872
* Support gemini models in openclaw by @cktang88 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3837
* fix(mini-swe-agent): install litellm[mcp] so tool calls stop failing by @jfeldstein in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3867
* fix(tau3): declare MCP server support on Tau3LLMAgent by @cktang88 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3914
* fix(swe-agent): install litellm[mcp] so tool calls stop failing by @CatherineYin1213 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3854
* fix(regrade): don't import the source trial's agent to compute the setup timeout by @cktang88 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3937
* fix(tau3, opencode): declare reasoning_effort support on agents that take it by @cktang88 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3938
* feat(hf-sandbox): add namespace option by @aganezov in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3922
* fix(environments): keep downloaded logs when tar reports files changed during packing by @vancenate in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3935
* feat(environments): add Snowflake Cortex Sandboxes environment provider (--env snowflake) by @sfc-gh-kganesan in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3918
* feat(fx): read fx session logs for trajectories and token usage by @fazxes in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3956
* fix(registry): implement package dataset listing by @rominparekh in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3936
* docs(news): add "Cracking down on reward hacking" post by @alexgshaw in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3968
* fix(fx): price timed-out steps and each model reply correctly by @fazxes in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3969
* remind agent harness authors to reuse auth resolution by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3970
* Show hosted concurrency limits after job submission by @scvance in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3973
* fix(hosted): allow dynamic egress in gateway mode by @scvance in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3979
* Default CPU-only Modal Compose tasks to VM and support network policies by @vancenate in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3982
* e2b: prebuilt template reuse, create retries, renewable sandbox lease (main) by @mattteufel-e2b in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3460
* e2b: content-hash template names, resource-variant tags, launch by build ID by @mattteufel-e2b in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3461
* docs: correct task and verifier configuration references by @alexgshaw in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3988
* Use the credential proxy default for new hosted CLI submissions by @scvance in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3985
* e2b: run as the image user with the image environment and PATH, like docker exec by @mattteufel-e2b in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3462
* e2b: tag sandboxes by job and trial, log failed kills by @mattteufel-e2b in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3463
* e2b: re-attach to a running command when its stream drops by @mattteufel-e2b in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3522
* copilot-cli: report token usage and cost via `--usage-output-file` by @shibbas in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3990
* feat: support NeMo Fabric 0.6 in the native agent by @AjayThorve in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4016
* fix(modal): tolerate binary exec output and drain both streams by @Skylion007 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3934
* Use Modal VM runtime with runtime="vm" instead of legacy experimental_options by @clairec03 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3915
* feat(runta): support sandbox automatic shutdown and deletion by @ADD-SP in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3997
* Rename ACP runner control variables to ACP_RUNNER_* by @andy-zhou in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3834
* fix(terminus-2): shrink tmux paste chunks to fit Modal's exec arg limit by @cktang88 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4033
* Add hosted credential proxy configuration models by @scvance in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4017
* feat(server): HCP v0 rollout server by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3974
* feat(server): add inference relay server by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3975
* feat(connector): between proxy and relay as an example by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3976
* feat(server): add shared read models and SQL inspection views by @alexgshaw in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4038
* feat(server): add list filters and nonblocking SQLite access by @alexgshaw in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4039
* feat(server): add read-only SQL queries and authorized downloads by @alexgshaw in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4040
* feat(tensorlake): default to CAS sandbox images by @cooltx7eel in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4049
* Export Codex subagents as ATIF trajectories with correct usage by @psurkov in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3435
* fix(antigravity): install coreutils for stdbuf by @praneethprathi in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4048
* refactor(server): move job submissions to /jobs/submit by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4053
* feat: add boxd environment provider by @MichielMAnalytics in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2778
* feat(boxd): require boxd>=0.3.0 and run machines in a chosen region by @MichielMAnalytics in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4058
* fix(rewardkit): score unreadable inputs instead of aborting grading by @benediktstroebl in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4024
* fix(rewardkit): align judge prompt example with the schema and make response format configurable by @benediktstroebl in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4026
* test(rewardkit): reuse the sandbox image and stabilize the sweep-attack test by @benediktstroebl in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4027
* fix(rewardkit): handle a zero turn budget and close sqlite connections by @benediktstroebl in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4025
* feat(rewardkit): add on_error judge policy and reject out-of-range scores by @benediktstroebl in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4028
* Ignore unqualified Compose hosts in Modal egress allowlists by @scvance in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4059
* feat(environments): add Superserve sandbox provider by @meAmitPatil in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4037
* feat(cwsandbox): add scratch emptyDir volumes by @anson627 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2868
* fix(server): require API key authentication by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4063
* feat(server): expose Harbor operations as MCP tools by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4064
* refactor(server): generate MCP tools from API routes with FastMCP by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4072
* ci: install only Ruff for lint and format checks by @alexgshaw in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4083
* ci: harden comment-triggered workflows and pin actions by @stbenjam in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4080
* fix(agents): classify Anthropic's low credit balance error as ApiUsageLimitError by @ashtonchew in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4068
* fix(viewer): allow rerunning failed job analysis by @redswimmer in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4044
* perf(job): compute live metrics off the event loop by @no-hup in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4043
* feat(viewer): add folder and rollout API source boundary by @alexgshaw in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4050
* feat(viewer): reuse existing UI for rollout servers and controls by @alexgshaw in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4066
* fix(computer-1): accept framework kwargs like override_setup_timeout_sec and load_trajectory by @cktang88 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4081
* Select hosted secrets with source, tag and delivery alias by @scvance in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4052
* fix(modal): enable network policies for GPU Compose tasks by @scvance in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4087
* fix(trajectory): handle long JSON strings in the validator by @Excelius-Wang in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4075
* feat(server): expose artifact downloads as an MCP tool by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4094
* test(beam): avoid live registry lookup in mount startup test by @stbenjam in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4090
* feat(rewardkit): balance scores in the judge response example by @Clement-Lelievre in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4079
* fix(rewardkit): an explicit reweight from a second file no longer double-registers the criterion by @zhongerdeajie in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3608
* fix(rewardkit): keep file and directory times when staging Worker files by @AysajanE in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4086
* fix(server):encrypted per-job environment overrides by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4109
* fix(rewardkit): retry an LLM judge reply that has no content by @alran in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4097
* refactor(server): use Idempotency-Key for submission and retry by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4110
* refactor(viewer): send Idempotency-Key headers by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4111
* chore: replace retiring Sonnet 4.5 in examples, docs, and defaults by @stbenjam in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4106
* fix(rewardkit): retry a judge score its criterion's schema does not allow by @alran in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4103
* feat(client): add synchronous and asynchronous Harbor API clients by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4115
* feat(environments): add typed options and schema discovery by @alexgshaw in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4114
* feat(environments): add Azure Container Apps Sandboxes environment by @Philmod in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3704
* fix(openclaw): honor model_api_format by setting the provider api by @cktang88 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4104
* feat(cli): submit and watch jobs with --server by @alexgshaw in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4116
* error policy remove failure cause by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4141
* feat: serialize error policies and reward validity by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4142
* fix: count rewards from unclassified trial errors by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4144
* fix: derive automatic retries from the shared error policy by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4145
* fix: apply error grading policy during trial execution by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4146
* fix: apply reward validity consistently to scores and summaries by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4147
* fix: reuse finished source trials with valid rewards by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4148
* refactor: define error policy flags explicitly by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4150
* feat: support per-job error policy overrides by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4151
* fix: do not retry nonzero agent exits by default by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4152
* docs: update error policy classification and overrides by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4153
* refactor: rename error policy flags by @alexgshaw in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4156
* fix(ci): respect cancellation in test summary jobs by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4154
* Tidy trial artifact handling by @scvance in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4172
* fix(blaxel): use SDK 0.4.24 long-poll process.wait in exec; fixes import on mcp 2 by @SystemSculpt in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4092
* docs: add Harbor birthday news by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4171
* docs: rename news heading to Streaming by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4178
* fix(deps): bump grpcio to 1.85.1 for updated bundled TLS roots by @stbenjam in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4175
* docs: add error classification news by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4177
* docs: add Terminal-Bench 4.1 news by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4179
* fix: honor Antigravity CLI gateway authentication by @scvance in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4180
* Use port 8390 by default for Harbor serve by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4186
* Document Harbor serve and its API by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4187
* ci: read reviewer mentions config from the default branch by @stbenjam in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4200
* feat(agents): add native opencode-v2 integration by @Yagouus in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4127
* fix(vibe): pin `--python 3.12` for `mistral-vibe` install by @frvnkliu in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4190
* fix(daytona): stop leaking sandboxes on failed creates and dead clients by @danielgraviet in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4095
* fix(antigravity-cli): keep gateway subagents on the selected model by @cktang88 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4138
* feat(aca-sandbox): enforce network policy via sandbox egress policy by @Philmod in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4196
* fix(vibe): set `UV_OFFLINE=0` for `mistral-vibe` install by @frvnkliu in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4191
* fix(muse-code): support verified release version pinning by @vancenate in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4217
* feat(copilot-cli): add `disallowed_tools` and `fusion_tier` options by @pvaneck in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4236
* ci: migrate all workflows to Blacksmith by @blacksmith-sh[bot] in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4246
* Remove /jobs/resolve by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4223
* Rename submission input job to config by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4224
* Group SDK methods by resource by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4226
* Generate idempotency keys in the SDK by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4227
* Use force for cancellation controls by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4228
* Align API pagination with Hub by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4229
* Support dry runs in job submission by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4237
* Support bulk job and rollout actions by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4238
* Group rollout attempts and expose retry history by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4244
* test(superserve): remove flaky timeout kill test by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4251
* feat(serve): expose agent and sandbox discovery APIs by @alexgshaw in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4245
* feat(mcp): expose agent and sandbox discovery tools by @alexgshaw in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4252
* feat(sdk): add agent and sandbox discovery resources by @alexgshaw in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4253
* docs(serve): publish discovery API and SDK reference by @alexgshaw in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4254
* fix(tinker): Accurate cost estimation and cache usage by @mmaaz-git in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4232
* fix(copilot-cli): map reasoningText to reasoning_content in ATIF conversion by @123XieC in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4149
* fix(antigravity-cli): support verified version pinning by @vancenate in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4170
* feat(copilot-cli): add `disabled_mcp_servers` and disable `github-mcp-server` by default by @pvaneck in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4243
* ci: remove unused review and preview workflows by @alexgshaw in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4272
* Persist and upload complete config snapshots by @alexgshaw in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4259
* Separate sparse config templates from full printed records by @alexgshaw in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4260
* Version job and trial config and result schemas by @alexgshaw in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4250
* feat(server): add client attribution headers by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4279
* fix(serve): include all rollout attempts in lists by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4266
* fix(serve): return resolved trial count for dry runs by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4267
* fix(serve): align API errors with RFC 9457 by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4275
* feat(server): upload jobs to Harbor Hub by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4278
* fix(agents): make pipefail setup portable by @jjbuck in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4277
* feat(server): add usage and job completion telemetry by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4282
* fix(viewer): style retry history and default to latest attempts by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4286
* fix(server): keep requests responsive during rollout dispatch by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4284
* chore(antigravity-sdk): upgrade google-antigravity to 0.1.23 by @vietnnguyen in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4289
* fix(viewer): put Rollouts first on job pages by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4288
* refactor(server): restore single-resource action endpoints by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4294
* Refine viewer navigation, rollout controls, and cancellation by @alexgshaw in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/4291
